It’s not just Co Kerry and Ireland backing Jessie Buckley for Oscar glory - Stratford-upon-Avon is too.

The success of the film ‘Hamnet’ is driving a significant surge in visitors to William Shakespeare’s historic sites in the UK town.

Buckley has been nominated for the Academy Award as Best Actress for her performance as Shakespeare’s wife Agnes Hathaway.
